name: Zain CDC Kuwait
developer: Zain Kuwait / Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.
notes: Colocation data center listed at Ghazali Rd 60000 Al Ahmadi; sources describe purpose-built multi-tenant CDC with full cabinet rentals, remote hands, high-capacity internet/data services, dark fiber and physical security. Operational status inferred from service listings.

name: NBK Data Center
notes: Data Center Catalog lists National Bank of Kuwait data center in Farwaniya; no public capacity found.

name: Boubyan Bank Data Center
notes: Bank data center received Uptime Institute Tier III Gold Certification of Operational Sustainability in 2023 after Tier III design certification in 2020 and constructed facility certification in 2022; article says facility spans basement/ground/first floors with 99 data cabinets. ProTenders lists Kuwait City; consultant post places it at Ardiya, which is in Farwaniya Governorate.

name: Gulf Bank Hawally IT Data Center Facility
notes: Gulf Bank official press release announced inauguration of a new IT data center facility in Hawally; included for division coverage although it is enterprise/bank infrastructure rather than a commercial colocation project. No public capacity found.

name: Google Cloud Kuwait Region - Al-Mutlaa / Digitus DC colocation site
developer: Google Cloud Services Company SPC Kuwait / Digitus DC / State of Kuwait
notes: Google announced a planned Kuwait cloud region in 2023. GLA says Digitus DC signed a multi-year agreement to provide several MW of colocation hosting space for Google at Al-Mutlaa, with the broader initiative including three new Google data centers. Kuwait Times later reported Municipal Council approval for water pipeline routes to supply Google Cloud's data center in Al-Mutlaa. Al-Mutlaa is in Jahra Governorate; exact IT capacity not disclosed.

name: Google Cloud planned data center - Sulaibiya station supply area
developer: Google Cloud Services Company SPC Kuwait / State of Kuwait
notes: Times Kuwait reported KD 22m was allocated for three main conversion stations in Sulaibiya, north of South Saad Al-Abdullah, and Al-Mutlaa, each to supply power to a planned Google Cloud data center. Sulaibiya is treated as Jahra Governorate. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Google Cloud planned data center - South Saad Al-Abdullah supply area
developer: Google Cloud Services Company SPC Kuwait / State of Kuwait
notes: Times Kuwait reported a planned Google Cloud data center supplied by a main conversion station north of South Saad Al-Abdullah, as part of three approved power stations for Google Cloud centers. Location mapped to Jahra Governorate; capacity not disclosed.

name: Gulf Data Hub GDH-KWT-001 Kingfisher
notes: Tensor EPC portfolio lists GDH-KWT-001 Kingfisher in Jaber El Ahmad City, Kuwait, for Gulf Data Hub, 1.9 MW IT, Tier III Active, 2 data halls, period Jul 2025 - ongoing. Jaber Al-Ahmad City mapped to Jahra Governorate.

name: Gulf Data Hub GDH-KWT-002 Kite
notes: Tensor EPC portfolio lists GDH-KWT-002 Kite in Sulaibiya City, Kuwait, for Gulf Data Hub, 1.9 MW IT, Tier III Active, 2 data halls, period Jul 2025 - ongoing. Sulaibiya mapped to Jahra Governorate.

name: Agility Logistics Parks Kuwait Data Center Campus
notes: Agility/ALP announced a master-planned Kuwait data center campus in an existing logistics park with an 80 MW substation, 15+ MW solar capacity, and two 46,000 sqm data center plots with expansion capacity above 100,000 sqm. Agility Logistics Park in Kuwait is associated with Sulaibiya, mapped to Jahra Governorate. Capacity_mw uses the disclosed substation/campus capacity rather than signed IT load.

name: Microsoft AI-powered Azure Region Kuwait
notes: Microsoft official announcement says partnership with CAIT and CITRA intends to establish an AI-powered Azure Region in Kuwait. Exact data center site and capacity are not public; assigned to Capital because announcement and national cloud-region activity are centered on Kuwait City until a specific site is disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Kuwait Data Center
notes: Ooredoo official page lists data center services including hosting, co-location, monitoring, managed storage, backup/restoration, business continuity, connectivity and cloud services. Data Center Catalog places the facility at Al-Sour Street, Kuwait City 13007; NavLink says it was designed/built to Tier III specifications. No public capacity found.

name: Ooredoo Kuwait sovereign AI-enabled data center
notes: Ooredoo Kuwait announced launch of Kuwait's first sovereign AI-enabled data center with NVIDIA H200 GPU infrastructure at the Al-Jarida MoneyTech Summit. Source references Ooredoo headquarters in Kuwait City; exact facility address and capacity not disclosed.

name: KEMS Zajil Telecom Primary Data Center
notes: KEMS official page describes its primary data center at Keifan Exchange - MOC Building Ground Floor, with secondary facility at Osama Tower, Fahad Al-Salem Street, Kuwait City. Zajil official page describes redundant backbone, power and environmental systems. Keifan/Kuwait City mapped to Capital Governorate. No public capacity found.

name: KEMS Zajil Telecom Secondary Data Center
notes: KEMS official page states it has a secondary data center on the 2nd Floor of Osama Tower, Fahad Al-Salem Street, Kuwait City, 10 km from the primary data center. Data Center Catalog lists the same Kuwait City address and cabinet services. No public capacity found.

name: stc Kuwait / Qualitynet Data Center
developer: solutions by stc / Kuwait Telecommunications Company
notes: Data Center Map lists the stc Kuwait Data Center in Kuwait City and notes Qualitynet was acquired by stc in 2019 and rebranded as solutions by stc in 2022. SAMENA confirms Qualitynet became solutions by stc and was an enterprise/ICT solutions provider. No public capacity found.
